sections.text_helper: Section 63.9.9 "I2C PEC register (I2C_PECR)" in chapter 63 (Inter-integrated circuit interface (I2C)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3165.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x20
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Access: no wait states
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 PEC[7:0]: Packet error checking register
This field contains the internal PEC when PECEN=1.
The PEC is cleared by hardware when PE = 0.
